spawn_spec.prompt:
TASK: Refactor the just-added native Ferryx session persistence compatibility implementation into the smallest maintainable, typed forward-compatible design without changing observable behavior. This is an executable assignment, not a review.
DELIVERABLE: Replace the brittle current approach in `src-tauri/src/session/mod.rs` that encodes v2/v3 layout metadata inside fake `terminalSessions` keys such as `__ferryx_meta:*` and contains hundreds of lines of manual serde. Preserve actual frontend v1/v2/v3 session JSON through load-save-load, including multiple workspaces, terminal pane structures, browser `profileId`/`worktreePath`/`worktreeLabel`, tab groups/layouts, per-worktree layouts, and terminal local/backend IDs. Maintain existing Rust public v1 struct literal construction at all current call sites. Modify only `src-tauri/src/session/mod.rs`, `src-tauri/tests/session_persistence_integration.rs`, and direct Rust tests whose struct literals require new explicit default fields.
SCOPE: First read the current source and locate all uses of public persisted structs. Prefer serde-derived DTOs with explicit optional fields and/or `#[serde(flatten)]` unknown-field preservation over fake terminal session metadata and handwritten serde transformations. Keep atomic fsync/rename behavior unchanged. No unsafe, no lossy `serde_json::Value` at top-level session if a typed field is reasonable, and no new dependencies. Do not touch frontend or unrelated Rust behavior and do not commit.
RED/GREEN: Retain the existing load-save-load typed-v2 regression but first change it to assert no `__ferryx_meta:` entries are emitted in `terminalSessions`; capture RED against the current source. Then implement the smallest production refactor that turns it GREEN.
VERIFY: From src-tauri run exactly: `cargo test --test session_persistence_integration -- --test-threads=1`, `cargo test session::tests`, and `cargo check`; all pass. Run `git diff --check` for your scope. Report RED/GREEN counts and final changed LOC (`git diff --numstat`).
STOP WHEN: Native persistence preserves all actual frontend fields with no fake-meta session records, all three commands are green, and the implementation is materially smaller/simpler than the current manual serde layer.
